mapper.select: SELECT IPTN_NO AS iptnNo, IPPR_SEQ AS ipprSeq, IPPR_ID AS ipprId, MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq FROM ODS.S_MSERMMLD WHERE IPTN_NO = #{examKey} ORDER BY IPPR_SEQ

SELECT A.MDFM_CPEM_ID AS id, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID AS parentId, A.ELMT_CCLS_CD AS controlType, A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD AS classType, CASE WHEN A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD != 'V' THEN A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE ELSE ISNULL(B.DCST_LDAT, B.IPTN_CNTE) END AS text FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MSERMDTD B ON B.IPPR_ID = #{ipprId} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = B.MDFM_CPEM_ID WHERE A.MDFM_ID = #{mdfmId} AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = #{mdfmFomSeq} ORDER BY A.MDFM_CPEM_ID, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_ID
